title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-29
source: Recorded By Mason Taylor on a Nakamichi 550 Cassette Deck, on chrome tapes, with Nakamichi microphones; Transferred on Mason's restored Nak550

ai_review.summary: A solid Red Rocks performance captured with good taper positioning, regarded as the best of the three‑night run and sounding great in a car.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this show highly (4 ★), praising the overall energy of the concert and noting that the taper’s placement delivers clear, enjoyable sound—especially for listening on the road. While no specific songs or technical flaws are called out, the consensus is that the recording quality is strong enough to make this night stand out among the three shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 4 ★ and focus on positive aspects of both performance and audio, but with only two brief comments the confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes excellent taper positioning and improving sound across the three nights; no specific issues mentioned, indicating a clear and listenable capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure, but reviewers describe the overall experience as epic and enjoyable.
